payload.summary: Shift swaps that approve themselves on accept skip the team's hours and run-length rules
payload.detail: Manager approval was fixed in PRs #3571 and #3574: the server rechecks every team rule and requires an acknowledgement. Remaining gap (rechecked 2026-10-21 on main 81ba5ae): a same-grade swap more than 7 days out approves itself in roster_command on accept, which checks only clashes and the minimum break, not maximum hours or nights or days in a row. Fix needs a migration so such swaps wait for the manager; owner decision requested in the Work tools hardening plan.
